caption:
Medicare open enrollment is on. 🏥

It runs Oct 15 to Dec 7. CMS says Medicare Advantage premiums are projected to drop in 2027, but the cap on yearly out-of-pocket Part D drug costs goes up to $2,400 from $2,100.

The plan you picked last year may not be the best one now.

Do you or your parents review the plan every year?
first_comment: Do you compare plans every year or just renew? 👇
